name: 16_demand_limited_window
description: Demand-limited transfer window: asks 30 @ 120 and 20 @ 125 meet a single bid 10 @ 125. A proposal at 125 is rejected (S = 50 > D = 10 and the asks below 125 exceed D); at 120 the demand-limited branch clears 10 units (s_below = 0 < D = 10 ≤ S = 30): the ask at p* is filled first-come and gets 20 units back, the ask above p* is returned whole, the buyer pays 120 + 1% fee and is refunded the rest of its escrow. A later window with max_bid < min_ask settles NO_MATCH and returns every order.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces, prior/income commitments, liquidity flags) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.
